name: Rocco Arena
note: THE KEY RECORD. Age 39 in March 1900 and indexed year of birth 1861 -- which CONFIRMS the family tree's birth year for Rocco Arena, and does so from a source entirely independent of it. Recorded as a US CITIZEN, so he had naturalised: he was in America years before this, and his son Antonio was born at New York in 1895.

name: Anna Arena
note: Rocco's daughter, born 17 January 1893 (Scilla act 22). The tree puts her crossing in 1894, when she would have been one; the manifest puts it at 23 May 1899, aged six. She did not travel with her father.

name: Giavanni Arena
note: Same ship, same film, same frame, the line IMMEDIATELY ABOVE six-year-old Anna. He was the adult she travelled with. Age 45 gives a birth about 1854, which does not match the Giovanni Arena of act 230 (b. c.1859) well; the manifest image would show the relationship column.

name: Michele Donato
note: SECOND INDEPENDENT WITNESS TO 1856. Act 162 of 1892 makes him 36 in July 1892; this manifest makes him 52 in 1908. Both give a birth about 1856 and neither supports the tree's 1851. The only New Orleans arrival among 49 Michele Donato records in the collection, and it matches the tree's stated port and year.

name: Giuseppe Polistena
note: Candidate for the tree's Giuseppi Polistena b. 1875, Giovanni Polistena's elder brother. Two years out on the age, which is ordinary.

name: Maria Polistena
note: On the line immediately after Giuseppe -- a married couple travelling together.

name: Giovanni Donato
note: LINE 2 -- immediately after Annunziata Polistena. A Polistena and a Donato teenager side by side on one manifest in 1903, nine years before Giovanni Polistena married Nunziata Donato. The families were already travelling together.

name: Pasquale Donato
note: Same ship, same frame as Lorenjo Costa two lines below.

name: Lorenjo Costa
note: Two lines below Pasquale Donato. Costa is Generosa Costa's surname; Donato is Michele's.
